profile.summary: India's largest paint and home-decor company. Makes and sells decorative paints (interior and exterior emulsions, enamels, wood finishes, putty, waterproofing, adhesives) under Asian Paints, Royale, Apex, Tractor, Ace, Apcolite, SmartCare and other brands; runs kitchens (Sleek), bath fittings (Ess Ess), decorative lighting (White Teak), uPVC windows (Weatherseal) and furnishings (Nilaya); industrial coatings through two 50:50 JVs with PPG of the US; paint operations in 13 countries outside India.
profile.plantsAndCapacity: 27 paint manufacturing facilities worldwide with installed capacity of 1.85 mn KL a year (ICICI Direct, 30-Jul-2026)
profile.retailReach: ~1.7 lakh retail touchpoints in India (ICICI Direct, 30-Jul-2026); 6,000+ touchpoints added in FY26 (MD, 29-May-2026 call)
profile.beautifulHomesStores: 74 Beautiful Homes stores in 20 states (Q4FY26 deck, 29-May-2026)
profile.newProductShare: New products (launched within three years) ~17% of revenue in Q4FY26 and Q1FY27 (14% in Q4FY25, 16% in Q3FY26)
profile.subsidiaries: 24 subsidiaries (19 international) and 2 JVs at 31-Mar-2026 (AR FY26 Board's report)
profile.src: AR FY26 (Integrated Annual Report 2025-26); Q4FY26 and Q1FY27 investor presentations; ICICI Direct Q1FY27 note

reporting.segments: No reportable segments: the group reports a single segment, 'Paints and Home Decor' (Ind AS 108, AR FY26 note 36). Business lines are disclosed only in the quarterly investor deck: decorative India volume and value growth, standalone financials, international (AP Global), kitchen, bath, White Teak, Weatherseal, PPGAP and APPPG revenue and PBT.
reporting.modelBasis: We model two lines that reconcile exactly to reported numbers: (1) Standalone = Asian Paints Ltd (decorative paints in India, which is ~97% of it, plus kitchens and bath fittings and some standalone industrial sales); (2) Subsidiaries and consolidation = consolidated less standalone (international, APPPG industrial coatings, White Teak, Weatherseal, white cement, Harind, less inter-company eliminations). PPGAP is an associate (equity method): only its profit share appears, inside other income.
reporting.src: AR FY26 note 36 and 37; quarterly decks

q1fy27.mixPct: +3% (MD on the call; PL and ICICI Direct: ~4% price + ~3% mix realised)

callPoints: Volume growth ~9% 'across the months'; rural and T3/T4 towns ahead of T1/T2 cities; B2B projects strong in urban markets.

Weighted price increase ~7% in Q1 (taken in April, May and June); with the mix of increases, the pricing effect should be ~8-9% in Q2. No further increase intended 'unless the situation really becomes alarming'.
Material inflation ~25% in Q1; low-cost finished-goods inventory 'seeped through in 1Q'; Q2 is seasonally lower-margin and will carry the higher-cost inventory.
FY27 guidance kept: decorative volume growth 8-10%; consolidated PBDIT margin 18-20%.
Value growth will stay above volume growth 'till the time we get into pricing corrections'; price changes in H2 'could trigger demand even further' (i.e. cuts are possible if raw materials fall).

Competitive intensity 'seems to be at an all-time high'; discounting most intense in economy products, where contractors can be converted with higher discounts. Medium and large players gained from smaller ones during supply disruptions.

VAM-VAE plant (Dahej): first phase from August 2026; 1,00,000 t VAM and 1,50,000 t VAE; 2-2.5 years to approach 150,000 t; 300-500 bp gross-margin benefit on products that use in-house emulsion. White cement plant in Fujairah (UAE) 'fully operational'.
Industrial JV price increases lag (key accounts); margins down ~120 bp in both JVs; management expects industrial to keep outgrowing decorative.

rawMaterials.mix: TiO2 is the largest single raw material by value and is not crude-linked; monomers, solvents and other crude derivatives are (MD, 29-Jul-2026). Material is only ~35-40% of the consumer's cost per square foot; labour is the rest (MD, 29-May-2026).
rawMaterials.cycle: FY26: material deflation every quarter (~1.4% in Q4FY26), standalone gross margin a record 45.6% in Q4FY26. From Mar-2026 the West Asia conflict drove inflation: impact 'closer to about 20%' vs ~11% passed on by end-May (MD, 29-May-2026); ~25% inflation in Q1FY27 vs ~7% weighted price increase realised. Dealers cite ~13-14% list-price increases by June (Nomura's question on the call); ICICI Direct: 'calibrated price hike of 14%'. Monomer prices started easing in June; TiO2 started rising at end-June.

capexAndCapacity.newPlants: Proposed water-based paint plant in Madhya Pradesh: 4 lakh KL a year, ~Rs2,000 cr, operations within three years of environmental clearance. Second UAE paint plant (Abu Dhabi): AED 140 mn (~Rs340 cr), 55,800 KL a year.

May-2025: 'Rs700-800 cr outflow this year and probably a similar number next year' (Parag Rane) - FY26 came in higher.

history.event: Founded in Mumbai by four friends as a partnership
history.impact: Origin of today's promoter families (Choksi, Dani, Vakil)
Leadership held for almost six decades

history.event: Two 50:50 JVs with PPG of the US: PPG Asian Paints (automotive OE, packaging, marine) and Asian Paints PPG (protective, powder, road marking)
history.impact: PPGAP is equity-accounted (FY26 revenue Rs2,468 cr); APPPG is consolidated with a 50% minority (FY26 revenue Rs1,334 cr). JV agreements extended by 15 years in FY26

history.event: International expansion (Berger International, SCIB Egypt, Apco Fiji, Taubmans, Causeway Sri Lanka, Kadisco Ethiopia)
history.impact: Operations in 13 countries; international ~9% of group revenue (FY26 Rs3,340 cr); loss-making Indonesia exited in FY25

history.event: Buys Sleek (kitchens) and the Ess Ess bath-fittings business
history.impact: Home-improvement foray; FY26 kitchen revenue Rs400 cr, bath Rs347 cr; both near break-even or loss-making

history.event: Buys controlling stakes in White Teak (decorative lighting) and Weatherseal (uPVC windows); launches VAM-VAE and white-cement backward integration (~Rs9,000 cr group capex plan)
history.impact: Capex Rs2,496 cr in FY24; White Teak impaired in FY25 and FY26

history.event: Grasim launches Birla Opus with ~Rs10,000 cr of planned investment
history.impact: Start of the most serious competitive challenge in decades; Asian Paints' revenue fell 4.5% in FY25

history.event: Weak demand plus competition: decorative volume +2.5%, value -5.7%; consolidated EBITDA margin 17.7%, EPS -33% to Rs38.2
history.impact: Exceptional charges Rs363 cr (Ethiopia devaluation, White Teak and Causeway impairments, Indonesia exit loss)

history.event: Reliance (Siddhant Commercials) sells 3.64% to SBI MF at Rs2,201 and a further ~85 lakh shares in a later block deal
history.impact: SBI MF becomes a 5% holder; DIIs rise to ~21%

history.event: Buys remaining 40% of White Teak for Rs188 cr (27-Jun-2025); sells 4.42% stake in Akzo Nobel India for ~Rs734 cr (9-Jul-2025) after JSW Paints agreed to buy control of Akzo India
history.impact: Akzo India becomes JSW Dulux, a second deep-pocketed rival

history.event: CCI orders a DG investigation into alleged abuse of dominance on Grasim's complaint
history.impact: Open at 30-Sep-2026; potential penalty up to 10% of turnover if abuse found

history.event: Volume recovers (+8.7%); record standalone gross margin on deflation; EPS +18% to Rs45.1
history.impact: Exceptional charges Rs158 cr (White Teak intangibles, labour code)

history.event: West Asia conflict drives ~20-25% raw-material inflation; industry raises prices ~13-14% in steps
history.impact: Q1FY27 revenue +18%, EBITDA +34% on low-cost inventory; Q2 to carry the higher costs
